findings.summary: Cast `err.status as 422` lies to the type-checker; runtime status is correct but the literal annotation is wrong for any non-422 AppError.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace `as 422` with a Hono ContentfulStatusCode cast: import { ContentfulStatusCode } from 'hono/utils/http-status' and use `err.status as ContentfulStatusCode`.

findings.summary: When userId is present, a second withRequestId child logger is created instead of adding a binding to the existing child.
findings.suggested_fix: Change line 28 to `const log = userId ? child.child({ userId }) : child;` so we rebind rather than rebuild the pino child.

findings.summary: refresh_token.user_id foreign key has no supporting index; per-user revocation and cleanup scans will be sequential as the table grows.
findings.suggested_fix: Append `CREATE INDEX refresh_token_user_id_idx ON refresh_token(user_id);` and add the matching `index('refresh_token_user_id_idx').on(t.userId)` declaration in apps/api/src/modules/auth/schema.ts.

findings.summary: authn reads env.JWT_SECRET from the eager-load singleton; consistent with sprint pattern but reinforces the wave-7 buildApp DI gap.
findings.suggested_fix: Track for wave-7: pass JWT secret into authn via factory/DI so buildApp can fail-fast on missing JWT_SECRET in tests without re-importing the env module.
